page: Microsoft Azure D96nds_v6 is a general purpose virtual machine operating on an x86_64 Intel processor architecture managed by the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance features 96 dedicated vCPUs and 384.0 GB of system memory, establishing a standard 1:4 core-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. It does not include hardware accelerators such as GPUs.

Storage configuration includes 5,670 GB of bundled local NVMe SSD capacity, providing low-latency ephemeral disk space for high-throughput I/O operations. The system is also Premium Storage capable for durable managed disk integration, though it does not provide complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The dense core count and large bundled NVMe storage provide high computational throughput and fast local scratch space within a single node. This resource profile suits large relational and NoSQL database engines, big data batch processing, distributed caching tiers, and enterprise-grade multi-threaded compilation workflows.
